name: GetFilesInFolder
label: Retrieve Files in Folder
description: This activity retrieves the list of files in a specified folder, with options to include subfolders and sort the results.

fields.name: FolderPath
fields.label: Folder Path
fields.description: Specifies the path to the folder where files will be retrieved.

fields.name: FileFilter
fields.label: File Filter
fields.description: A pattern to filter the files (e.g., "*.txt" for text files).

fields.name: IncludeSubfolders
fields.label: Include Subfolders
fields.description: If true, includes files from all subfolders within the specified folder.

fields.name: FailUponDeniedAccess
fields.label: Fail on Denied Access
fields.description: If true, the activity will fail if access to any subfolder is denied.

fields.name: SortBy
fields.label: Sort By
fields.description: The primary criterion to sort the retrieved files (e.g., "Name", "LastWriteTime").

selectOptions.label: FullName
selectOptions.description: Sort by the full file path.

selectOptions.label: RootPath
selectOptions.description: Sort by the root directory path.

selectOptions.label: Directory
selectOptions.description: Sort by the directory containing the file.

selectOptions.label: NameWithoutExtension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name without the extension.

fields.name: Descending
fields.label: Descending Order
fields.description: If true, sorts the files in descending order based on the primary sort criterion.

fields.name: ThenBy
fields.label: Then By
fields.description: The secondary criterion to sort the retrieved files (e.g., "Size", "CreationTime").

selectOptions.label: FullName
selectOptions.description: Sort by the full file path.

selectOptions.label: RootPath
selectOptions.description: Sort by the root directory path.

selectOptions.label: Directory
selectOptions.description: Sort by the directory containing the file.

selectOptions.label: NameWithoutExtension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name without the extension.

fields.name: RetrievedFiles
fields.label: Retrieved Files
fields.description: The list of files that were retrieved based on the specified criteria.
